COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
09.07.2024 WPPIL No. 120 of 2024
Hon’ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioners. 
2. Counsel for the petitioners has referred to the 
photographs – Annexure No. 10 to show that a parking 
area is being constructed near the Girls Inter College. 
He submits that the said action will adversely affect the 
running of the study classes, and disturbance in 
delivering lectures.
3. Notice of motion. 
4. Mr. K.N. Joshi, learned Deputy Advocate General 
for the State of Uttarakhand accepts notice on behalf of 
respondent nos. 1, 2, 4 & 6. 
5. Mr. Mukesh Rawat, learned counsel holding brief 
of Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for respondent 
no. 5.
6. On asking of the Court, Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, 
learned counsel has accepted notice on behalf of 
respondent no. 3 – Nagar Palika Parishad, Almora. 
Counsel for the petitioner will give a copy of the paper￾book to the counsel for respondent no. 3.
7. Counsel for respondent no. 3 will get instructions
in the matter. 
8. List on 13.08.2024.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.) 
 09.07.2024 09.07.2024
Rahul
